line: Jung on the quinta essentia (CW10, CW16, CW11, CW14, CW12, CW9ii); von Franz on the fifth in Number and Time.

sections.title: The quinta essentia
sections.line: The quinta essentia as the Philosophers' Stone and as the unity of the four: CW10 ¶738; CW16 ¶403; CW11 ¶104; CW14 ¶656.

quotes.quote: This is a symbol of the quinta essentia, which is identical with the Philosophers’ Stone.
the quintessential star, symbol of the unity of the four hostile elements.
Dorn breaks with the whole alchemical tradition inasmuch as he adopts the rigidly Christian standpoint that Three is One but Four is not, because Four attains to unity in the quinta essentia.
Thus the square at the beginning corresponds to the quaternio of elements united in the quinta essentia at the end

sections.title: The fifth apart from the four
sections.line: The fifth star, the fifth flower and the punctum solis, and earth as the fifth element: CW16 ¶402 and ¶410; CW9ii pdf p232; CW14 ¶249.

quotes.quote: Above, in the centre, there is a fifth star which represents the fifth entity, the “One” derived from the four, the quinta essentia.
The fifth flower comes from above and presumably represents the quinta essentia; it is brought by the dove of the Holy Ghost
but the 'punctum solis' is apart from these four, in the midst of the yolk (which) is the chick.

Earth occupies the central position as the fifth element, though it is not the quintessence and goal of the work but rather its basis, corresponding to terra as the arcane substance in Western alchemy.

sections.title: Its other names
sections.line: The quintessence as aether, and the names of the product: CW14 ¶270 and ¶452; CW12 ¶165.

quotes.quote: It is a symbol of the arcane substance and the quintessence, of the aether that contains all four elements

The establishment of the Maid in the fifth circle is an indication that the quintessence, portraying the disharmonious elements as a unity, is equivalent to aether, the finest and most subtle substance.
The product is generally called the “quintessence,” though this is by no means the only name for the ever-hoped-for

sections.title: Read psychologically
sections.line: The production of the quintessence as a psychic process: CW14 ¶749, ¶680 and ¶698.

quotes.quote: For us, who know that no amount of incineration, sublimation, and centrifuging of the vinous residue can ever produce an “air-coloured” quintessence, the entire procedure is fantastic if taken literally.
The Production of the Quintessence means if in the misery and incertitude of a moral or philosophical dilemma one has a quinta essentia, a lapis or a panacea so to say in one’s pocket!
If it “draws out the soul of Mercurius,” this means psychologically that the image of the self (the golden quaternity) draws a quintessence out of the chthonic spirit.

sections.title: Von Franz
sections.line: Von Franz on the quinta essentia: von Franz, Number and Time, pdf p77 and p132.

quotes.quote: The latter is not merely a fifth element added on to the four known ones, but represents their realized unity of existence.
The quinta essentia is not additively joined onto the first four as a fifth element
